# Chart dependencies

D3 7.9.0 is bundled locally from its published `dist/d3.min.js` distribution. Its source is [the D3 repository](https://github.com/d3/d3), and its required ISC licence is preserved in `D3-LICENSE`.

The comparison charts therefore remain available when external hosts cannot be reached. Observable Plot adoption remains a separate task in the linked fire storytelling plan, pending retrieval and checks with the actual library.
